title: Offline person edits and account isolation
rule: Persist person commands with stable request ids in a principal-and-deck keyed browser outbox before sending. Apply in server arrival order even over intervening agent values. Only acknowledged edits are saved. Deleted targets retain the rejected command for explicit restore; deleted decks stop writes. Reauthentication retains same-principal work; sign-out and account switch isolate it and never transmit it as another principal.
alternatives: Treat optimistic edits as server saved.
